claim: EGGLND is the SETTLED-egg handler and its first act is to load the hatch wait into the egg's own PJOYT workspace. This is the general egg wait — RAMDEF.SRC:393 declares EGGWT as 'TIME TO WAIT BEFORE STARTING EGG HATCHIN SEQUENCE' — and every egg that LANDS reaches it, whatever killed it.

source.verbatim: EGGLND	LDA	EGGWT		GET CURRENT WAIT TIME

claim: The wait is stored in the egg's PJOYT, the same per-process timer slot the enemy brains use for their own countdowns.

THE UNIT OF THE WAIT. The settled-egg loop costs a PCNAP 12 per pass, and the pass is what spends one tick of the wait — so a wait of n is n*12 DISPLAY FRAMES, not n frames. The nap sits between EGGLND's load (:3224) and the DEC PJOYT,U at :3236, and the BNE at :3237 closes the loop back above it, so the nap is paid once per decrement rather than once in total. Reading EGGWT as a frame count runs every egg hatch twelve times too fast.
The wait counts DOWN one per loop pass, and the loop repeats until it reaches zero. EGGLN2 (:3226) is the head this branches back to.
The wait loop's closing branch. Non-zero PJOYT re-enters EGGLN2 and pays another PCNAP 12; only a zero falls through to the hatch.

EGGWT2 is a SEPARATE row from EGGWT and a separate wait: it is read once during EGG-WAVE setup, and RAMDEF.SRC:395 declares it 'TIME TO WAIT BEFORE STARTING EGG HATCHIN (EGG WAVES)'. So an egg-wave egg enters holding EGGWT2 while an egg that lands takes EGGWT. At GA1 5 the two differ from wave 1 onward (56 vs 64), so wiring one row to both paths is observable, not cosmetic.

source.verbatim: LDB	EGGWT2		INITIAL EGG WAITING TIME

claim: DEATH3 TRANSFERS the dying enemy's remaining egg count to the egg it leaves rather than inventing a fresh complement. The count lives on the BIRD (PEGG), and this is the first half of the cycle that walks it down toward permadeath.

source.verbatim: LDA	PEGG,U		TRANSFER NBR OF EGG LEFT

claim: The transferred count is then decremented — the egg costs the enemy one of its four. The BNE at :3002 branches away while the result is non-zero ('BR=YOU CAN GET MORE EGGS'), so only the decrement that REACHES ZERO falls through to the scoring block below.

source.verbatim: DEC	PEGG,Y		YOU CAN ONLY SQUEEZE SO MUCH BLOOD FROM AN EGG

claim: THE VICTOR GUARD. Before scoring the last egg the ROM loads the victor's workspace and skips the award entirely when it is zero — a death with no victor (the lava troll's) earns nobody anything. The BEQ target 1$ is the routine's own epilogue at :3007, the same label the eggs-remaining BNE at :3002 takes.

source.verbatim: LDU	,S		GET VICTORS WORKSPACE (CURRENTLY DIEING ENEMY)

claim: EGGSCR's SECOND call site, and the one this port did not model. An enemy's LAST egg is scored to the victor at the moment of the kill, with no catch required — distinct from the PLYEGG catch site at :3021 that jt8-4 wired. grep 'JSR EGGSCR' over JOUSTRV4.SRC returns exactly these two.

The hatch hands the egg count BACK to the buzzard that remounts. This is the half that makes permadeath reachable at all: without it every remounted bird forgets its count, the four-egg complement is effectively infinite, and the DEATH3 award at :3006 can never fire in play.

source.verbatim: LDA	PEGG,U		MAINTAIN NBR OF EGGS LEFT IN THE BIRD
